metadata.title: मानगढ़ धाम पर राजकुमार रोत | Interview Rajkumar Roat | Bhil Pradesh Map
metadata.description: On 17th July, we met Rajkumar Roat, Member of Parliament and a prominent tribal leader, at Mangad Dham in Rajasthan. In this exclusive conversation, he spoke about the demand for Bhil Pradesh — a proposed separate state for the tribal communities of western India. Watch this important discussion on the vision, concerns, and aspirations behind the Bhil Pradesh movement.
